notes:
Account snapshot: EmberDock RankFlow is a mid-market SaaS that provides a hosted knowledge-base and helpdesk augmentation product for high-velocity B2B customers. They ingest enterprise KBs (release notes, KB articles, transcripts). Looking for hosted API for speed of onboarding + Redwood Optimize for cost/quantization recommendations.

Key business drivers:
- High QPS support: anticipated production steady-state ~1.5k-3k qps across US/EU regions (peak bursts to 5k).
- Moderate index scale: ~25-35M vectors (avg dim 1536).
- Tight latency goals: p50 <50ms, p95 <120ms (search + rerank combined).
- Cost-sensitive: target <$0.0008 per user query including on-the-fly reranking.

What they already use / baseline:
- Currently evaluating Pinecone + separate cross-encoder service for rerank; considering switching embeddings provider.
- Some customers already using OpenAI embeddings internally; EmberDock wants vendor-neutral option and prefix-caching for repeated queries.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key wrapping, audit logs retention 1 year, and EU data residency for EU customers. SOC2 evidence is required before procurement.

POC plan discussed:
- Week 1: ingest 5M sample vectors, validate retrieval quality vs their Golden prompts.
- Week 2: scale to 25M vectors, run steady-state 72h throughput test at 2k qps across two regions. Measure CPU/GPU utilization and token-level cost.
- Week 3: run rerank latency profile (top-10 cross-encoder) and produce cost-per-query breakdown with and without quantized models.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If we can hit your p50 and keep cost < $0.0008, we can justify replacing our current stack." — Head of Infrastructure (Samir Gupta).
- AE notes: "Wants clear fallback plan if capacity constrained — routing to cheaper quantized variant acceptable."

Commercial signals:
- Budget range appears in $75k-$200k ARR band if hosted pricing meets latency and residency requirements.
- Prefers monthly metered contract for initial 6 months, then evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput.

Open action items for Redwood:
- Provide SOC2 package and EU residency whitepaper (drive link shared).
- Deliver a hosted API throughput runbook + expected autoscaling behavior for 2k-5k qps.
- Produce a sample cost model: estimate token & inference cost for embedding + ANN + cross-encoder rerank for their 28M vector projection.
